q: Action-angle variables (I,θ) for an integrable system reduce the Hamiltonian to H = H(I) (function of actions only). The dynamics in these coordinates is:
exp: In action-angle coordinates: İ = −∂H/∂θ = 0 (H is θ-independent), θ̇ = ∂H/∂I = ω(I). Actions are constants of motion; angles increase linearly in time. Motion is quasi-periodic on invariant tori with frequencies ω(I).
